cards.description: 该内容介绍 Pi Durable 作为 Pi 生态中支持常驻智能体应用的构建块，通过检查点、会话和存储实现中断恢复，并演示本地 llama.cpp 运行 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的恢复流程。
cards.titleEn: Pi Durable: Crash Recovery for Always-On Agents with Local Models
cards.summary: Pi Durable 是常驻智能体应用的构建块，而非新的编码智能体 CLI，利用检查点、会话和存储支持中断后恢复。演示基于本地 llama.cpp 运行 Qwen3.5-0.8B，展示从 SQLite 恢复中断工作的脚本。作者指出 API 为实验性，工具重放安全性和宿主进程重启仍需应用负责。
cards.summaryEn: Pi Durable is a building block for always-on agent applications, not a new coding-agent CLI, using checkpoints, conversations, and storage to support recovery after interruptions. The demo runs Qwen3.5-0.8B locally with llama.cpp and includes a second script that resumes interrupted work from SQLite. The author notes the APIs are experimental, and tool replay safety and host process restart remain application responsibilities.
cards.originalTitle: Pi Durable EXPLAINED: Build Always-On Agents with Local Models
cards.whyItMatters: 为构建始终在线的本地模型智能体应用提供了可恢复性的架构思路和可复现的演示路径，有助于理解应用层需自行承担的安全与重启责任。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers an architectural approach and reproducible demo path for building recoverable always-on local-model agent applications, helping clarify the safety and restart responsibilities that remain at the application layer.
keyPointsEn: Pi Durable provides checkpoint, conversation, and storage mechanisms for crash recovery of always-on agents.
The content distinguishes harness versus application responsibilities in the Pi ecosystem and outlines six steps to initialize a harness.
The local-model demo uses llama.cpp with Qwen3.5-0.8B and includes a second script that resumes interrupted work from SQLite.
keyPoints: Pi Durable 提供检查点、会话和存储机制，用于常驻智能体的崩溃恢复。
内容区分了 Pi 生态中 harness 与应用的职责，并给出初始化 harness 的六个步骤。
本地模型演示使用 llama.cpp 和 Qwen3.5-0.8B，包含从 SQLite 恢复中断工作的第二个脚本。
cards.limitationsEn: Pi Durable APIs are experimental and may change; tool replay safety and host process restart are not handled automatically by Pi Durable and must be addressed by application developers. The demo covers only a specific local model and recovery scenario, without large-scale or production validation.
cards.limitations: Pi Durable 的 API 仍为实验性，可能发生变化；工具重放的安全性和宿主进程重启并非由 Pi Durable 自动处理，需要应用开发者自行负责。演示仅覆盖特定本地模型和恢复场景，未涉及大规模或生产环境验证。
cards.title: Pi Durable：本地模型常驻智能体断点恢复机制
cards.descriptionEn: This content introduces Pi Durable as a building block in the Pi ecosystem for always-on agent applications, enabling recovery after interruptions via checkpoints, conversations, and storage, and demonstrates a local llama.cpp demo with Qwen3.5-0.8B.

cards.description: 该研究提出多变量状态依赖Hawkes过程，建模荷兰EPEX SPOT日内连续市场中15分钟与小时合约的跨产品流动性动态，并区分正常与压力两种市场状态。新在于量化了跨产品激发在压力下的方向减弱与速度加快，有助于理解重叠合约间的隐藏流动性依赖。
cards.titleEn: Cross-Product Hawkes Model Reveals Liquidity Dependence in Intraday Electricity Markets
cards.summary: 研究用多变量状态依赖Hawkes过程分析15分钟与小时日内连续合约的订单流交互，发现订单流主要由自身历史驱动（约95%），跨产品激发主要从15分钟合约流向小时合约。压力状态下，该领导关系减弱（累积跨激发比从2.8降至1.5），且15分钟到小时的激发滞后从6.05秒缩短至0.93秒。作者据此认为压力下两合约影响趋于对称、季节差异消失。
cards.summaryEn: Using a multivariate state-dependent Hawkes process, the study analyzes order flow interactions between quarter-hourly and hourly intraday continuous contracts, finding that order flow is overwhelmingly self-driven (about 95%) and cross-excitation runs mainly from quarter-hourly to hourly contracts. Under stress, this leadership weakens (cumulative cross-excitation ratio falls from 2.8 to 1.5) and the quarter-hourly-to-hourly excitation lag shortens from 6.05 to 0.93 seconds. The authors interpret this as contracts influencing each other almost equally under stress and seasonal differences disappearing.
cards.originalTitle: Cross-product Modelling in Continuous Intraday Electricity Markets via Hawkes Processes
cards.whyItMatters: 该建模框架为理解重叠粒度合约间的隐藏流动性依赖提供了可校准工具，对市场稳定性和短期平衡分析有参考价值；但结论基于特定市场与时段，不宜直接外推为交易策略依据。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The modeling framework offers a calibratable tool for understanding hidden liquidity dependencies among overlapping granularity contracts, with reference value for market stability and short-term balancing analysis; however, conclusions are based on a specific market and period and should not be directly extrapolated as trading strategy guidance.
keyPointsEn: Order flow is predominantly self-excited: about 95% of orders arrive in reaction to earlier orders in both normal and stressed regimes.
Cross-excitation runs mainly from quarter-hourly to hourly contracts; under stress the cumulative cross-excitation ratio falls from 2.8 to 1.5, weakening this leadership.
Stress makes the quarter-hourly-to-hourly channel much faster, cutting mean lag from 6.05 to 0.93 seconds, and the seasonal variation in calm periods largely disappears under stress.
keyPoints: 订单流以自激发为主，约95%的订单是对更早订单的反应，正常与压力状态均如此。
跨产品激发主要从15分钟合约流向小时合约，压力下累积跨激发比从2.8降至1.5，领导关系减弱。
压力使15分钟到小时通道显著加快，平均滞后从6.05秒降至0.93秒，且平静期的季节差异在压力下消失。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from Level 3 limit order book data of the Dutch EPEX SPOT intraday continuous market for the first month of each quarter in 2024; the normal and stressed regimes are classified by a composite metric of bid-ask spread, mid-price volatility, and queue imbalance, with thresholds not specified in the abstract; the model captures statistical excitation relationships without causal identification; robustness across markets, products, and longer samples is unknown.
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自荷兰EPEX SPOT日内连续市场2024年每季度首月的Level 3限价订单簿数据；正常与压力状态由买卖价差、中间价波动和队列失衡的复合指标划分，划分阈值未在摘要中说明；模型为统计激发关系，未建立因果识别；跨市场、跨产品及更长样本的稳健性未知。
cards.title: 跨产品Hawkes模型揭示日内电力市场流动性依赖
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes a multivariate state-dependent Hawkes process to model cross-product liquidity dynamics between quarter-hourly and hourly contracts in the Dutch EPEX SPOT intraday continuous market, distinguishing normal and stressed regimes. Its novelty lies in quantifying how cross-product excitation weakens in direction and accelerates in speed under stress, helping to understand hidden liquidity dependencies among overlapping contracts.

cards.description: 提出一个识别并量化逻辑关联预测市场合约间套利机会的框架，基于凸包条件判定套利存在性、用整数规划构建最优组合，并通过回放Polymarket订单簿模拟执行，量化扣除费用后的收益与机会持续特征。
cards.titleEn: Combinatorial Arbitrage in Prediction Markets: Identification Framework and Empirical Replay
cards.summary: 该研究构建框架，证明价格落在可行支付向量凸包之外时存在套利，并用整数规划求解最优套利组合。作者利用平台元数据和解析标准语义恢复约190万条逻辑关系，覆盖超过25.5万个合约，回放Polymarket全深度订单簿模拟执行。结果显示，已结算组合在扣除价差和费用后的保证利润为投入资本的2.2%，到期利润为3.2%；关系发现与执行成本更高处的套利机会持续更久且参与更少。
cards.summaryEn: The study builds a framework proving that prices outside the convex hull of admissible payoff vectors admit arbitrage and uses integer programming to identify optimal arbitrage portfolios. Using venue metadata and semantic analysis of resolution criteria, the authors recover about 1.9 million logical relations covering more than 255,000 contracts and replay full-depth Polymarket order books to simulate execution. Among settled portfolios, guaranteed profit after spreads and fees equals 2.2% of committed capital, while profit at resolution reaches 3.2%; arbitrage opportunities persist longer and attract less observed participation where relation discovery and execution are more costly.
cards.whyItMatters: 为跨合约预测市场套利提供了可复现的识别、优化与回放评估框架，并将关系发现与执行成本同套利机会的持续性和参与度联系起来，对理解预测市场定价效率具有参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a reproducible framework for identifying, optimizing, and replay-evaluating cross-contract arbitrage in prediction markets and links relation-discovery and execution costs to the persistence and participation of arbitrage opportunities, useful for understanding pricing efficiency.
keyPointsEn: Proves that prices outside the convex hull of admissible payoff vectors admit arbitrage and solves optimal portfolios via integer programming.
Recovers about 1.9 million logical relations from metadata and semantic analysis of resolution criteria, compiling constraint systems covering over 255,000 contracts.
Replaying Polymarket order books shows guaranteed profit after spreads and fees of 2.2% of committed capital for settled portfolios, with profit at resolution of 3.2%.
keyPoints: 证明价格位于可行支付向量凸包外即存在套利，并以整数规划求解最优组合。
从元数据和解析标准语义恢复约190万条逻辑关系，构建覆盖超25.5万合约的约束系统。
回放Polymarket订单簿显示，已结算组合扣除价差与费用后保证利润为投入资本2.2%，到期利润3.2%。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from replay simulation of Polymarket order books rather than live capital execution; results depend on the coverage and accuracy of relation extraction, liquidity assumptions in order-book snapshots, and fee structures, and generalizability to other markets or periods requires further validation.
cards.limitations: 证据来自对Polymarket订单簿的回放模拟而非真实资金执行，结果依赖关系提取的覆盖与准确性、订单簿快照的流动性假设以及费用结构；不同市场或时段的适用性需进一步验证。
cards.title: 预测市场组合套利：识别框架与实证回放
cards.descriptionEn: Develops a framework to identify and quantify arbitrage across logically related prediction-market contracts, using a convex-hull condition for arbitrage existence and integer programming for optimal portfolios, with order-book replay on Polymarket to quantify net profits and persistence.

cards.description: 提出 AOI 多智能体框架，在安全约束下将自动运维建模为轨迹学习问题。其创新在于通过失败轨迹闭环进化器将失败转化为监督信号，并在 AIOpsLab 上验证了运行时、GRPO 训练和进化器的累积增益。
cards.titleEn: AOI Framework: Turning Failed Trajectories into Training Signals for Cloud Diagnosis
cards.summary: 作者提出 AOI 框架，将自动云诊断形式化为安全约束下的轨迹学习问题，包含可训练诊断系统、读写分离执行架构和失败轨迹闭环进化器。在 AIOpsLab 基准上，AOI 运行时单独达到 66.3% best@5，加入 Observer GRPO 训练后 14B 模型在未见故障类型上平均@1 达 42.9%，进化器将 37 条失败轨迹转化为诊断指导，端到端平均@5 提升 4.8 点、方差降低 35%。作者认为这些组件能累积提升性能并支持持续学习。
cards.summaryEn: The authors present AOI, a framework that formulates automated cloud diagnosis as a security-constrained trajectory learning problem, comprising a trainable diagnostic system, a read-write separated execution architecture, and a failure trajectory closed-loop evolver. On the AIOpsLab benchmark, the AOI runtime alone achieves 66.3% best@5; adding Observer GRPO training enables a locally deployed 14B model to reach 42.9% avg@1 on unseen fault types; the evolver converts 37 failed trajectories into diagnostic guidance, improving end-to-end avg@5 by 4.8 points and reducing variance by 35%. The authors view these components as cumulatively improving performance and enabling continual learning.
cards.originalTitle: AOI: Turning Failed Trajectories into Training Signals for Autonomous Cloud Diagnosis
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作表明，在权限受限的企业环境中，通过读写分离架构和失败轨迹再利用，可在不暴露敏感数据的前提下持续提升开源模型的自动运维诊断能力。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work shows that in permission-constrained enterprise environments, a read-write separated architecture and reuse of failed trajectories can continually improve open-source models' automated operations diagnosis without exposing sensitive data.
keyPointsEn: The AOI runtime achieves 66.3% best@5 on all 86 tasks, outperforming the prior state of the art (41.9%) by 24.4 points.
A locally deployed 14B model after Observer GRPO training reaches 42.9% avg@1 on 63 held-out tasks with unseen fault types, surpassing Claude Sonnet 4.5.
The failure trajectory closed-loop evolver converts 37 failed trajectories into diagnostic guidance, improving end-to-end avg@5 by 4.8 points and reducing variance by 35%.
keyPoints: AOI 运行时在全部 86 个任务上达到 66.3% best@5，超过先前最优 41.9% 达 24.4 点。
本地部署的 14B 模型经 Observer GRPO 训练后，在 63 个含未见故障类型的留出任务上平均@1 达 42.9%，超过 Claude Sonnet 4.5。
失败轨迹闭环进化器将 37 条失败轨迹转化为诊断指导，使端到端平均@5 提升 4.8 点，方差降低 35%。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is limited to the AIOpsLab benchmark and does not cover real enterprise production environments; the failed trajectory sample is small (37), and the generalizability of its conversion effect remains to be verified; the comparison with Claude Sonnet 4.5 is restricted to specific task sets without reported statistical significance.
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自 AIOpsLab 基准，未涉及真实企业生产环境；失败轨迹样本量较小（37 条），其转化效果的泛化性有待验证；与 Claude Sonnet 4.5 的比较限于特定任务集，未报告统计显著性。
cards.title: AOI 框架：将失败轨迹转化为云诊断训练信号
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes the AOI multi-agent framework that formulates autonomous operations as a trajectory learning problem under security constraints. Its novelty lies in converting failed trajectories into supervision signals via a failure trajectory closed-loop evolver, with cumulative gains validated on AIOpsLab.

cards.description: 该研究提出OrderFlowDiT，一种条件扩散Transformer，用于联合预测未来五分钟买卖盘口各价位的非归一化成交量，并引入非平衡最优传输（UOT）辅助损失以显式考虑价格位移与总量信息。同时构建全字段评估框架，结合对价格位置和总量敏感的传输成本、适当评分规则与校准诊断来评估预测分布。
cards.titleEn: OrderFlowDiT: Transport-Regularized Diffusion Transformer for Probabilistic Limit-Order Supply Forecasting
cards.summary: 作者研究给定当前订单簿和近期订单流时，未来五分钟限价订单量在价位上的条件分布，认为需同时捕捉价格位置、总量与预测不确定性。他们提出OrderFlowDiT，并加入非平衡最优传输辅助损失；在30只美股、1950个验证条件上的主要对比显示，与仅用均方误差训练相比，全字段传输成本降低45.8%，传输能量分数降低26.1%，且每只股票均有改善。评估框架结合传输成本、适当评分规则与校准诊断，主张联合评估字段准确性与预测不确定性。
cards.summaryEn: The authors study the conditional distribution of limit-order volume across price levels over the next five minutes given the current order book and recent order flow, arguing that price placement, total volume, and predictive uncertainty must be captured jointly. They propose OrderFlowDiT with an unbalanced optimal transport auxiliary loss; in the primary comparison on 30 U.S. equities and 1950 validation conditions, adding UOT reduces full-field transport cost by 45.8% and transport energy score by 26.1% relative to training with mean squared error alone, with improvements for every stock. The evaluation framework combines transport cost, proper scoring rules, and calibration diagnostics to assess field accuracy and predictive uncertainty together.
cards.originalTitle: OrderFlowDiT: Transport-Regularized Diffusion Transformer for Probabilistic Limit-Order Supply Forecasting
cards.whyItMatters: 限价订单供给预测需要同时考虑价格放置、总量和不确定性；若忽略价格几何或总量信息，可能无法准确刻画联合分布。该工作将传输几何引入生成建模，并提供联合评估框架，对量化研究中订单流建模与不确定性评估具有方法参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Limit-order supply forecasting requires jointly considering price placement, total volume, and uncertainty; ignoring price geometry or total volume may fail to characterize the joint distribution. By introducing transport geometry into generative modeling and providing a joint evaluation framework, this work offers methodological reference for order flow modeling and uncertainty evaluation in quantitative research.
keyPointsEn: OrderFlowDiT uses a conditional diffusion Transformer to model unnormalized bid and ask volume-at-price fields, trained with an unbalanced optimal transport (UOT) auxiliary loss.

In the primary comparison across 30 U.S. equities and 1950 validation conditions, adding UOT reduces full-field transport cost by 45.8% and transport energy score by 26.1% relative to MSE-only training, with improvements for every stock.

The study proposes a full-field evaluation framework that combines a transport cost sensitive to price placement and total volume with proper scoring rules and calibration diagnostics to jointly assess field accuracy and predictive uncertainty.
keyPoints: OrderFlowDiT使用条件扩散Transformer建模未归一化的买卖盘口量-价字段，并以非平衡最优传输（UOT）辅助损失训练。
在30只美股、1950个验证条件的主要对比中，加入UOT使全字段传输成本较仅用MSE训练降低45.8%，传输能量分数降低26.1%，且所有股票均改善。
研究提出全字段评估框架，结合对价格位置和总量敏感的传输成本、适当评分规则与校准诊断，以联合评估字段准确性和预测不确定性。
cards.limitationsEn: Results are based on specific experiments with 30 U.S. equities and 1950 validation conditions; generalizability to other markets, asset classes, or time scales is not established. The abstract does not report training cost, latency, or online trading performance, so actual trading profitability cannot be inferred. Evaluation depends on the chosen transport cost and scoring rules; metric improvements do not guarantee full joint-distribution fidelity and do not constitute investment advice.
cards.limitations: 结果基于30只美国股票和1950个验证条件的特定实验，未说明在其他市场、资产类别或时间尺度上的可推广性；摘要未报告训练成本、延迟或在线交易表现，不能据此推断实际交易收益；评估依赖所选传输成本与评分规则，指标改善不等同于联合分布完全保真，也不构成投资建议。
cards.title: OrderFlowDiT：用传输正则化扩散Transformer预测限价订单供给
cards.descriptionEn: The study introduces OrderFlowDiT, a conditional diffusion Transformer for jointly forecasting unnormalized bid and ask volume-at-price fields over the next five minutes, with an unbalanced optimal transport (UOT) auxiliary loss to explicitly account for price placement and total volume. It also develops a full-field evaluation framework combining a transport cost sensitive to price placement and total volume with proper scoring rules and calibration diagnostics.

cards.description: 该研究指出金融新闻语言模型常因训练与测试年份重叠而引入后见之明偏差，并提出仅用1976-1995年文本预训练的NoLBERT来构建新闻主题，在126万篇2012-2024年文章上比较不同主题提取方法对美股收益预测的影响。其意义在于系统检验了无后见之明主题提取的可行性与稳定性，并揭示注意力冲击度量窗口选择对预测效果的关键作用。
cards.titleEn: Reading News Without Hindsight: NoLBERT Topics and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns
cards.summary: 研究使用仅基于1976-1995年文本预训练的NoLBERT，通过对比学习微调为句子编码器，生成新闻主题并用其构造注意力冲击与股票暴露，预测美国前1000大股票收益。实验在2013-2019年拟合、2020-2021年验证、2022-2024年测试，发现验证集表现最好的模型在所有调仓频率下均亏损；将注意力冲击的参照窗口从5个交易日延长至63个交易日可提升所有读者的测试秩IC。NoLBERT主题最稳定，预测表现与LDA相当；组合所有读者和模型的等权策略月净夏普为1.12，在未调整搜索前显著异于零，但相对于仅价格基准不显著。
cards.summaryEn: The study uses NoLBERT, an encoder pretrained only on 1976-1995 text and contrastively fine-tuned into a sentence encoder, to generate news topics and build attention shocks and stock exposures for forecasting returns of the 1,000 largest U.S. stocks. Models are fitted on 2013-2019, validated on 2020-2021, and tested on 2022-2024; the best validation model loses money at every rebalancing frequency, and extending the attention-shock reference window from 5 to 63 trading days raises test rank IC for all readers. NoLBERT produces the most stable topics and forecasts about as well as LDA; an equal-weight combination of all readers and models earns a monthly net Sharpe ratio of 1.12, significant against zero before search adjustment but not against a price-only benchmark.
cards.originalTitle: Reading the News Without Hindsight: NoLBERT Topics and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns
cards.whyItMatters: 研究提示，金融新闻主题模型若在训练数据上覆盖测试期，回测可能高估预测能力；采用无后见之明预训练编码器（如NoLBERT）可减轻该偏差。同时，注意力冲击的参照窗口选择对预测效果有实质影响，组合策略的增益需对照价格基准与多重搜索进行调整后谨慎解读。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study warns that financial news topic models trained on data overlapping the test period can overstate predictive ability; hindsight-free pretrained encoders such as NoLBERT can mitigate this bias. The choice of attention-shock reference window materially affects forecast performance, and the combined strategy's gains should be interpreted cautiously after adjusting for the price benchmark and multiple search.
keyPointsEn: The model with the best validation score loses money out-of-sample (2022-2024) at every rebalancing frequency, suggesting validation-based selection may not generalize.
Changing the attention-shock reference window from 5 trading days to the past 63 trading days raises test rank IC for all topic extractors (LDA, MiniLM, FinBERT, NoLBERT).

NoLBERT yields the most stable topics and forecasts about as well as LDA; the equal-weight combination of all models and readers has a monthly net Sharpe of 1.12 but is not significant relative to a price-only benchmark.
keyPoints: 验证集上表现最佳的模型在样本外（2022-2024）所有调仓频率下均亏损，说明验证集选择可能无法泛化。
将注意力冲击的参照窗口从5个交易日改为过去63个交易日，可提升所有主题提取方法（LDA、MiniLM、FinBERT、NoLBERT）的测试秩IC。
NoLBERT生成的主题稳定性最高，预测表现与LDA大致相当；等权组合所有模型与读者月净夏普1.12，但相对仅价格基准不显著。
cards.limitationsEn: The study covers 1.26 million articles from 2012 to 2024 and the 1,000 largest U.S. stocks, limiting sample period and market scope; the best validation model loses out-of-sample, the equal-weight combination is not significant versus the price benchmark, and multiple comparisons from model search are not adjusted; NoLBERT's pretraining corpus (1976-1995) differs in language and market structure from the test period, so results should not be directly extrapolated to other markets or asset classes.
cards.limitations: 研究使用2012-2024年126万篇文章和美国前1000大股票，样本期与市场范围有限；验证集最优模型样本外亏损，等权组合相对价格基准不显著，且未调整模型搜索带来的多重比较问题；NoLBERT预训练语料（1976-1995）与测试期存在语言与市场结构差异，结论不宜直接外推至其他市场或资产类别。
cards.title: 无后见之明读新闻：NoLBERT主题与股票收益预测
cards.descriptionEn: The study addresses hindsight bias in financial news language models, which often train on text overlapping the test period, and proposes NoLBERT—pretrained only on 1976-1995 text—to construct news topics. It compares topic extractors on 1.26 million articles from 2012 to 2024 for predicting U.S. stock returns, systematically testing the feasibility and stability of hindsight-free topic extraction and highlighting the role of the attention-shock measurement window.

cards.description: 该研究在凹性幂律冲击和Hurst缩放价格波动下，将执行期限选择与交易路径形状联合建模，提出以夏普比率最大化确定最优执行窗口，并给出基于凸规划的路径解析解。
cards.titleEn: Trading Horizon and Execution Schedule under Concave Impact and Hurst Scaling
cards.summary: 经典执行模型通常假设线性冲击、扩散价格和外生期限。本文在凹性冲击与Hurst缩放价格波动下，以交易实现盈亏的夏普比率最大化选择执行期限，并推导给定窗口下的最优交易路径形状。作者指出，当两个关键量同为正时存在内点最优期限，否则订单应以最快或最慢允许速度执行；路径形状由KKT条件给出，在Hurst缩放包络下呈前载且平滑衰减。
cards.summaryEn: Classical execution models typically assume linear impact, diffusive prices, and an exogenous horizon. This paper selects the execution horizon by maximizing the Sharpe ratio of the trade's realized P&L under concave impact and Hurst-scaled price fluctuations, and derives the optimal schedule shape for a given window. The authors show that an interior optimal horizon exists when two key quantities are both positive; otherwise the order should be executed at the fastest or slowest admissible pace, and the schedule under a Hurst-scaled envelope is front-loaded and tapers smoothly.
cards.originalTitle: From Alpha to Execution: Trading Horizons, Regimes, and Schedules under Concave Impact and Hurst Scaling
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架将执行期限与路径形状纳入统一优化，为量化交易执行提供了可解析的条件与路径形式，有助于在凹性冲击和长期记忆价格波动环境下评估执行节奏与成本。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework integrates execution horizon and schedule shape into a unified optimization, providing analytical conditions and schedule forms for quantitative execution, helping evaluate pacing and cost under concave impact and long-memory price fluctuations.
keyPointsEn: The execution horizon is chosen to maximize the Sharpe ratio of realized P&L, with price fluctuations and concave impact jointly affecting cost and risk.
An interior optimal horizon exists only when two quantities are both positive: impact persistence elasticity and net urgency rate; otherwise boundary speeds are optimal.
For a given window, the optimal schedule satisfies φ ∝ (λ − w(t))_+^{1/β}, has a closed form under a Hurst-scaled envelope, and saves envelope cost relative to TWAP.
In the interior regime, the first-order condition involves no impact coefficient, order size, or volume, and the objective is flat, implying a wide range of near-optimal windows.
keyPoints: 执行期限由交易实现盈亏的夏普比率最大化决定，价格波动和凹性冲击共同影响成本与风险。
内点最优期限存在的条件是两个量同为正：冲击持续弹性与净紧迫率；否则应选择边界速度。
给定窗口下，最优路径满足 φ ∝ (λ − w(t))_+^{1/β}，在Hurst缩放包络下具有闭式解并较TWAP节省包络成本。
内点区域的一阶条件不包含冲击系数、订单规模或成交量，且目标函数平坦，最优窗口范围较宽。
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions rely on a theoretical model with concave power-law impact and Hurst-scaled price fluctuations; existence of an interior optimum depends on the sign of net urgency and a structural prior on impact persistence elasticity. Numerical examples are limited to large-cap stocks, and the 10-17% cost savings and window flatness require validation with specific market parameters; this is not investment advice.
cards.limitations: 结论基于凹性幂律冲击与Hurst缩放价格波动的理论模型，内点最优的存在性依赖净紧迫率符号及冲击持续弹性的结构先验；数值示例仅针对大盘股，10-17%的成本节省和窗口平坦性需结合具体市场参数验证，不构成投资建议。
cards.title: 凹性冲击与Hurst缩放下的交易执行期限与路径优化
cards.descriptionEn: The study jointly models execution horizon choice and schedule shape under concave power-law impact and Hurst-scaled price fluctuations, proposing Sharpe ratio maximization to determine the optimal window and deriving an analytical schedule via convex programming.

cards.description: CastFlow 针对基于 LLM 的智能体时间序列预测中两个关键挑战——通过自适应工具交互获取预测相关证据，以及将证据转化为准确数值预测——提出角色分工框架：由冻结 LLM 借助经验记忆编排多视图工具包获取证据，再由专用轻量 LLM 进行证据驱动的时序推理以修正集成预测先验，并采用监督微调与可验证奖励强化学习两阶段训练。
cards.titleEn: CastFlow: Role-Specialized Agentic Framework Bridging Evidence Acquisition and Accurate Time Series Forecasting
cards.summary: 事实：CastFlow 是一个角色分工的智能体预测框架，包含经验记忆引导的工具获取与专用 LLM 的证据推理，并在十个真实基准中的九个上优于竞争基线。作者观点：连接自主证据获取与专用时序推理对准确且自适应的智能体预测具有重要意义。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: CastFlow is a role-specialized agentic forecasting framework comprising experience-memory-guided tool acquisition and specialized LLM evidence reasoning, outperforming competitive baselines on nine of ten real-world benchmarks. Author's view: bridging autonomous evidence acquisition and specialized temporal reasoning is important for accurate and adaptive agentic forecasting.
cards.originalTitle: CastFlow: Bridging Evidence Acquisition and Accurate Prediction in Agentic Time Series Forecasting
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为 LLM 智能体在时间序列预测中如何自适应获取证据并将证据转化为数值预测提供了可操作框架，并在多数基准上展示出优于竞争基线的表现，对推动智能体预测的准确性与自适应性有参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work provides an actionable framework for how LLM agents can adaptively acquire evidence and translate it into numerical predictions in time series forecasting, and demonstrates superior performance over competitive baselines on most benchmarks, offering reference value for advancing the accuracy and adaptivity of agentic forecasting.
keyPointsEn: Proposes a role-specialized framework: a frozen LLM orchestrates a multi-view toolkit for evidence acquisition, and a lightweight specialized LLM performs evidence-grounded temporal reasoning to refine an ensemble forecasting prior.
Introduces experience memory that distills successful tool-use trajectories from training data to guide the frozen LLM's tool interactions.

Designs a two-stage training strategy combining supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, where overall forecasting outcomes guide the optimization of the specialized model.
keyPoints: 提出角色分工框架：冻结 LLM 负责编排多视图工具包获取证据，轻量专用 LLM 负责证据驱动的时序推理并修正集成预测先验。
引入经验记忆，从训练数据中提炼成功的工具使用轨迹，以引导冻结 LLM 的工具交互。
设计两阶段训练策略，结合监督微调与可验证奖励强化学习，以整体预测结果指导专用模型优化。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: conclusions are based on outperforming baselines on nine of ten real-world benchmarks, not winning on all datasets; experience memory relies on successful tool-use trajectories from training data, and its generalizability is not fully discussed; the two-stage training involving reinforcement learning and verifiable reward design lacks quantification of computational cost and stability; although code is public, cross-domain transfer or real-time deployment validation is not mentioned.
cards.limitations: 证据边界：结论基于十个真实基准中的九个优于基线，未在所有数据集上胜出；经验记忆依赖训练数据中的成功工具使用轨迹，其泛化性未在文中充分讨论；两阶段训练涉及强化学习与可验证奖励设计，计算成本与稳定性未量化；代码虽公开，但未提及跨领域迁移或实时部署验证。
cards.title: CastFlow：角色分工智能体框架连接证据获取与精准时间序列预测
cards.descriptionEn: CastFlow addresses two key challenges in LLM-based agentic time series forecasting—acquiring forecast-relevant evidence through adaptive tool interactions and translating evidence into accurate numerical predictions—by proposing a role-specialized framework: a frozen LLM, guided by experience memory, orchestrates a multi-view toolkit for evidence acquisition, while a lightweight specialized LLM performs evidence-grounded temporal reasoning to refine an ensemble forecasting pr

cards.description: 提出RePlanMem-VLA方法，利用策略自身重规划时动作预测间的大分歧作为在线记忆写入信号，选择性存储视觉关键帧，以解决长程VLA策略需要历史视觉信息但全量存储昂贵冗余的问题。
cards.titleEn: Replanning-Guided Visual Memory for Long-Horizon VLA Policies
cards.summary: 长程多阶段VLA策略常需当前观测中已消失的视觉信息，全量保留历史计算昂贵且冗余，故需选择性视觉记忆。RePlanMem-VLA将策略重规划时相邻动作块对同一未来动作预测的异常大分歧视为任务相关事件，触发有界视觉记忆更新。在单任务自回归解码器和Flow-Matching Transformer上比较35种分歧度量，于OpenVLA-OFT和π0.5策略的MIKASA-Robo-VLA任务验证，检测器ROC-AUC达0.981-0.997，记忆保留实验100%保留任务相关观测至后续决策点。
cards.summaryEn: Long-horizon multi-stage VLA policies often require visual information no longer present in the current observation, and retaining complete history is computationally expensive and redundant, motivating selective visual memory. RePlanMem-VLA treats unusually large disagreement between temporally aligned predictions from consecutive action chunks as evidence of task-relevant events, triggering updates to a bounded visual memory. Compared 35 disagreement measures on single-task autoregressive decoder-only and Flow-Matching Transformers, validated on OpenVLA-OFT and π0.5 policies over MIKASA-Robo-VLA tasks, achieving ROC-AUC of 0.981-0.997, and preserving task-relevant observations until later decision points in 100% of episodes in memory-retention experiments.
cards.originalTitle: When Plans Change, Remember: Replanning-Guided Visual Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法将策略内部信号用于控制视觉记忆的写入，为长程VLA任务提供了一种无需完整历史存储的选择性记忆机制，有助于降低计算与存储开销，并可能提升任务相关信息的保留能力。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This method leverages policy-internal signals to control visual memory writes, offering a selective memory mechanism for long-horizon VLA tasks without full history storage, potentially reducing computation and storage costs and improving retention of task-relevant information.
keyPointsEn: Uses large disagreement between action predictions during replanning as an online memory-write signal.
Validated event detection across multiple VLA architectures and pretrained policies, achieving ROC-AUC of 0.981-0.997.
Preserved task-relevant observations until later decision points in 100% of episodes in memory-retention experiments.
keyPoints: 将重规划时动作预测间的大分歧作为在线记忆写入信号。
在多种VLA架构和预训练策略上验证事件检测，ROC-AUC达0.981-0.997。
记忆保留实验中100%保留任务相关观测至后续决策点。
cards.limitationsEn: Experiments are mainly based on the simulated benchmark MIKASA-Robo-VLA and specific pretrained policies (OpenVLA-OFT, π0.5); real-robot validation only uses replay data to verify event selection and redundancy suppression, without comprehensive evaluation in real closed-loop tasks; the disagreement measure comparison is limited to single-task settings, leaving multi-task generalization unknown.
cards.limitations: 实验主要基于仿真基准MIKASA-Robo-VLA和特定预训练策略（OpenVLA-OFT、π0.5），真实机器人仅使用回放数据验证事件选择与冗余抑制，尚未在真实闭环任务中全面评估；分歧度量比较限于单任务场景，多任务泛化性未知。
cards.title: 重规划引导的视觉记忆助力长程VLA策略
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes RePlanMem-VLA, which uses large disagreement between action predictions during policy replanning as an online memory-write signal to selectively store key visual frames, addressing the need for historical visual information in long-horizon VLA policies without expensive and redundant full history storage.

cards.description: 该GitHub项目提供库、代理和MCP服务器三种形态，在内容进入LLM前压缩工具输出、日志、文件与RAG片段。新意在于把压缩放在提示词入口而非模型内部，宣称编码代理可少用20%令牌、JSON类内容可少用60-95%令牌且答案不变。
cards.titleEn: Headroom: Compressing Tool Output and RAG Chunks Before the LLM
cards.summary: 项目自述为在LLM前压缩工具输出、日志、文件与RAG块。作者称编码代理令牌减少20%、JSON减少60-95%而答案相同。以上数字来自项目说明，未经独立验证。
cards.summaryEn: The project describes itself as compressing tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before the LLM. The authors claim 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60-95% fewer for JSON with unchanged answers. These figures come from the project description and are not independently verified.
cards.whyItMatters: 若压缩后答案质量稳定，可降低长上下文场景的令牌成本与延迟，对依赖工具调用和检索的编码代理尤具价值；但需自行验证实际效果。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If answer quality holds after compression, it could cut token cost and latency in long-context settings, which matters for coding agents that rely on tool calls and retrieval; users should verify the effect themselves.
keyPointsEn: Ships three integration forms: library, proxy, and MCP server
Compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks
Authors claim about 20% fewer tokens for coding agents
Authors claim 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON with the same answers
keyPoints: 提供库、代理、MCP服务器三种集成形式
压缩对象包括工具输出、日志、文件与RAG片段
作者宣称编码代理令牌减少约20%
作者宣称JSON类内容令牌减少60-95%且答案相同
cards.limitationsEn: All effect figures are self-reported, with no independent evaluation or reproduction details; the criteria for 'same answers' and the applicable models and task scope are unclear; compression may drop critical details, so high-stakes use should keep originals and involve human review.
cards.limitations: 全部效果数字来自项目自述，未提供独立评测或复现细节；'答案相同'的判定标准、适用模型与任务范围不明；压缩可能损失关键细节，高风险场景应保留原文并人工核验。
cards.title: Headroom：为LLM压缩工具输出与检索片段
cards.descriptionEn: This GitHub project ships a library, a proxy, and an MCP server that compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. Its novelty is compressing at the prompt entry point rather than inside the model, claiming 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60-95% fewer for JSON with the same answers.

cards.description: ComfyUI 是一个基于图/节点界面的扩散模型图形界面、API 与后端项目，在 GitHub 趋势日榜中出现。其价值在于把扩散模型的工作流拆成可组合节点，既提供可视化操作，也提供 API 与本地推理后端，方便按需搭建与复用流程。
cards.titleEn: ComfyUI: Node-Based Diffusion Model GUI and Backend
cards.summary: 事实：该项目自我描述为“最强大且模块化的扩散模型图形界面、API 与后端，采用图/节点界面”，并自称“世界上最快的本地推理引擎”。作者观点：上述“最强大”“最快”属于项目方的自我评价，输入材料未给出对应基准测试或对比数据。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: the project describes itself as the most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, API, and backend with a graph/nodes interface, and claims to be the fastest local inference engine. Author view: those superlatives are the project's self-description; the input provides no benchmarks or comparisons.
cards.whyItMatters: 对需要可视化编排扩散模型流程的开发者而言，节点式结构便于拆分、复用和调整推理步骤，API 与后端并存也便于把实验流程接入自有应用。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For developers who need to visually orchestrate diffusion model pipelines, node-based structure makes it easier to split, reuse, and adjust inference steps, while the API and backend allow integration into custom applications.
keyPointsEn: Offers a graph/node interface for organizing diffusion model workflows
Provides GUI, API, and backend rather than a single frontend tool
Positions itself as a local inference engine emphasizing modularity and composability
keyPoints: 提供图/节点式界面，用于组织扩散模型工作流
同时提供图形界面、API 与后端，而非单一前端工具
定位为本地推理引擎，强调模块化与可组合性
cards.limitationsEn: The input is only a GitHub trending daily project blurb, with no benchmarks, version notes, or independent evaluation; 'most powerful' and 'fastest' are self-claims and unverified. Specific performance, supported models, license, and hardware requirements are not provided, so conclusions are limited to stated positioning and features.
cards.limitations: 输入仅来自 GitHub 趋势日榜的项目简介，没有基准数据、版本说明或独立评测；“最强大”“最快”为项目方自述，未经验证。未提供具体性能、模型支持范围、许可证与硬件要求，结论仅限项目定位与功能描述。
cards.title: ComfyUI：节点式扩散模型图形界面与后端
cards.descriptionEn: ComfyUI is a diffusion model GUI, API, and backend built around a graph/node interface, surfaced in GitHub's daily trending list. Its value lies in decomposing diffusion workflows into composable nodes, combining visual operation with an API and local inference backend for building and reusing pipelines.

cards.description: GitHub 每日趋势中出现一个名为 withmarbleapp/os-taxonomy 的 JavaScript 仓库，提供操作系统分类体系。新意在于以开源形式公开该分类结构，便于复用与讨论；用处仅限于对分类框架本身感兴趣的场景。
cards.titleEn: Open-source operating system taxonomy repo trends on GitHub
cards.summary: 该仓库是 GitHub 每日趋势榜上的一个 JavaScript 项目，名称表明其主题为操作系统分类体系（taxonomy）。输入内容仅提供仓库名称、语言与趋势状态，未包含分类条目、设计动机或用例说明。因此任何关于其数据来源、覆盖范围和使用方式的判断均无法从现有材料得出。
cards.summaryEn: The repository is a JavaScript project on GitHub's daily trending list, with a name indicating an operating system taxonomy. The input only provides the repo name, language, and trending status, with no taxonomy entries, design rationale, or use cases. Claims about its data sources, coverage, or usage cannot be derived from the available material.
cards.whyItMatters: 操作系统分类体系可作为整理、检索和比较不同系统的结构化参考，以开源形式发布有助于他人复用或提出改进。但现有信息不足以判断其覆盖范围与维护质量，价值需查看仓库实际内容后评估。
cards.whyItMattersEn: An operating system taxonomy can serve as a structured reference for organizing, searching, and comparing systems, and an open-source release makes it easier for others to reuse or propose improvements. However, the available information is insufficient to judge its coverage or maintenance quality; its value requires reviewing the repository's actual content.

The input contains no specific entries, maintenance background, or usage notes

Therefore, the taxonomy's completeness, accuracy, or sustainability cannot be assessed, and nothing here constitutes technical selection or investment advice.

cards.title: 开源操作系统分类体系仓库登榜
cards.descriptionEn: A JavaScript repository named withmarbleapp/os-taxonomy appears on GitHub daily trending, offering an operating system taxonomy. Its novelty lies in publishing such a classification structure openly for reuse and discussion; its usefulness is limited to contexts that need the framework itself.

cards.description: Pi Durable 是 Hugging Face 介绍的一个 TypeScript 库，其核心新意在于对每个任务与工具调用做检查点（SQLite / JSONL），使进程重启后智能体能从上次中断处继续，而不是留下半完成的调用。它面向需要常驻运行的智能体构建场景，并支持在 llama.cpp 上本地运行 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的完全本地化部署。
cards.titleEn: Pi Durable: A TypeScript Library for Cr￼ash-Recoverable AI Agents
cards.summary: 源内容描述了常规编码智能体在崩溃后只留下半完成工具调用的问题，并称 Pi Durable 通过将每个任务与工具调用持久化为检查点来解决它。作者将其定位为用于构建常驻智能体的 TypeScript 库而非 CLI 工具，并提到可配合 llama.cpp 上的 Qwen3.5-0.8B 实现完全本地运行。可恢复性效果与本地部署性能属于源方陈述，输入中未给出基准测试或独立验证。
cards.summaryEn: The source describes regular coding agents leaving half-finished tool calls after a crash and claims Pi Durable addresses this by persisting every task and tool call as checkpoints. The author positions it as a TypeScript library for building always-on agents rather than a CLI, and mentions fully local operation with Qwen3.5-0.8B on llama.cpp. Recovery effectiveness and local deployment performance are source claims; the input provides no benchmarks or independent validation.
cards.originalTitle: Pi Durable: AI agents that survive crashes
cards.whyItMatters: 长流程智能体在发送邮件、写入文件等操作中途崩溃时，恢复成本高且易重复执行；检查点机制提供了一种减少重复工作与状态丢失的工程思路。对关注本地化、常驻型智能体部署的开发者具有参考价值。
cards.whyItMattersEn: When long-running agents crash mid-operation (sending emails, writing files), recovery is costly and prone to duplicated actions; checkpointing offers an engineering approach to reduce repeated work and state loss. It is relevant to developers building local, always-on agent deployments.
keyPointsEn: Records checkpoints per task and tool call in SQLite or JSONL, allowing execution to continue after a process restart.
Positioned as a TypeScript library for always-on agents, not a command-line tool.
Supports fully local operation, with examples using Qwen3.5-0.8B on llama.cpp.
keyPoints: 对任务与工具调用逐个记录检查点，存储于 SQLite 或 JSONL，进程重启后可继续执行。
定位为 TypeScript 库，用于构建始终在线的智能体，而非命令行工具。
支持完全本地运行，示例中配合 llama.cpp 上的 Qwen3.5-0.8B 模型。
cards.limitationsEn: The input contains only a project blurb plus tutorial and demo links; it provides no crash-recovery success rates, duplicate side-effect control, checkpoint overhead, or performance benchmarks. Local feasibility of Qwen3.5-0.8B with llama.cpp is a source claim without measured results. Reliability of SQLite/JSONL checkpoint writes within the crash window, along with concurrency and consistency issues, are not addressed, so conclusions should be treated as project claims rather than independently verified findings.
cards.limitations: 输入仅包含项目简介与教程、演示链接，未提供崩溃恢复成功率、重复副作用控制、检查点开销或性能基准数据。Qwen3.5-0.8B 配合 llama.cpp 的本地可行性仅为源方描述，未给出实测结果。检查点写入 SQLite/JSONL 本身在崩溃窗口内的可靠性、并发与一致性问题未说明，结论应视为项目声称而非经独立验证的结论。
cards.title: Pi Durable：通过任务检查点实现崩溃后恢复的智能体库
cards.descriptionEn: Pi Durable, presented by Hugging Face, is a TypeScript library whose stated novelty is checkpointing every task and tool call (SQLite / JSONL) so an agent resumes where it left off after a process restart, instead of leaving a half-finished tool call. It targets always-on agent builds and is described as usable fully locally with Qwen3.5-0.8B on llama.cpp.

cards.description: 该条目记录Import AI作者Jack Clark在通讯中表示已向国际货币基金组织（IMF）陈述“奇点已经开始”，新意在于将通用AI进展叙事带入国际金融治理场景；其价值在于为观察AI与宏观经济政策对话提供一个公开表达样本，而非提供可验证的技术或经济结论。
cards.titleEn: AI Commentator Tells the IMF That the Singularity Has Begun
cards.summary: 事实：Import AI第477期由Jack Clark撰写，标题表明作者向IMF表达“奇点已开始”的判断，原文摘要仅有一句“What do you think?”。作者观点：标题体现其对AI进展速度的强烈判断。证据边界：输入未提供向IMF陈述的具体内容、时间、场合或IMF回应，无法核实论证细节。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: Import AI issue 477 is by Jack Clark, and the title indicates the author told the IMF that the singularity has begun; the source summary is only 'What do you think?'. Author's view: the title reflects a strong judgment about the pace of AI progress. Evidence boundary: the input gives no details on what was said to the IMF, when, in what setting, or how the IMF responded, so the argument cannot be verified.
cards.originalTitle: Import AI 477: In which I tell the IMF the Singularity has begun
cards.whyItMatters: 把“奇点”这类技术叙事带入IMF这样的国际金融治理机构，反映AI进展讨论正与宏观经济、金融稳定议题产生交集；对研究者而言，这是一个观察AI政策话语如何进入国际机构场域的公开线索，但不应据此推导具体政策或市场结论。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Bringing a 'singularity' narrative into an international financial governance body like the IMF shows that AI progress debates are intersecting with macroeconomic and financial-stability issues. For researchers, it is a public clue about how AI policy discourse enters international institutions, but it should not be used to infer specific policy or market conclusions.
keyPointsEn: Import AI issue 477 is by Jack Clark, whose title says he told the IMF the singularity has begun.
The newsletter is an industry-observation source at the AI–quant intersection; this issue concerns AI's macro impact narrative.
The input provides only the title and a one-line summary, without the IMF statement text, data, or feedback.
keyPoints: Import AI第477期作者为Jack Clark，标题称其向IMF陈述奇点已经开始。
该通讯属于AI与量化交叉领域的行业观察来源，本期主题涉及AI宏观影响叙事。
输入仅提供标题和一句摘要，未包含IMF陈述的正文、数据或反馈。
cards.limitationsEn: The input contains only the title, author, publication time, source link, and the line 'What do you think?', with no full text, IMF meeting context, supporting data, or institutional response. It therefore cannot verify the basis for 'the singularity has begun' or confirm whether the IMF adopted the claim or was influenced by it. This item is not empirical evidence about AI progress or economic impact and contains no investment advice.
cards.limitations: 输入只有标题、作者、发布时间、来源链接和一句“What do you think?”，没有陈述全文、IMF会议背景、论证数据或机构回应。因此无法验证“奇点已开始”的依据，也不能确认该陈述是否被IMF采纳或产生政策影响；本条目不构成对AI发展速度或经济影响的实证判断，也不含投资建议。
cards.title: AI评论者向IMF陈述奇点已至的观点
cards.descriptionEn: This item records that Import AI author Jack Clark said in his newsletter that he told the International Monetary Fund (IMF) that 'the singularity has begun.' Its novelty lies in bringing a general-AI narrative into international financial governance; its usefulness is as a public example of AI–macro policy dialogue, not as verifiable technical or economic evidence.

cards.description: 这是一份聚合型链接摘要，其新意在于集中呈现量化研究社区近期讨论，并借Jeff Yass的引语点出核心问题：最大风险是误把亏损策略当成盈利策略。对量化研究者而言，它可作为追踪社区动态与反思策略评估假设的线索入口。
cards.titleEn: Quant Links Roundup Highlights Strategy Misjudgment Risk
cards.summary: 该内容为Quantocracy在2026年10月18日发布的近期量化链接汇总，属于社区链接聚合而非独立研究。文中引用Jeff Yass的观点：最大的风险在于你自以为拥有盈利策略，实际却是亏损策略。作者以个人收听播客的场景引出该引语，但摘要未展开具体论证或数据。
cards.summaryEn: This item is Quantocracy's roundup of recent quant links published on October 18, 2026; it is a link aggregation, not original research. It quotes Jeff Yass: the biggest risk is having a losing strategy when you think you have a winning one. The author introduces the quote through a personal podcast-listening anecdote, but the summary offers no further argument or data.
cards.originalTitle: Recent Quant Links from Quantocracy as of 10/18/2026
cards.whyItMatters: 对量化研究者来说，这类链接聚合可用于快速了解社区近期讨论方向；其中关于策略误判的提示，有助于在策略评估和回测解释中保持对过拟合与虚假盈利信号的警惕。但它本身不构成研究证据或操作建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For quant researchers, this kind of link roundup can quickly surface recent community discussion topics. The warning about strategy misjudgment can encourage vigilance about overfitting and false profit signals when evaluating strategies and interpreting backtests. However, it is not research evidence or operational advice.
keyPointsEn: The content is a Quantocracy roundup of recent quant links dated October 18, 2026.
The quote emphasizes a cognitive risk in quant strategy: misjudging whether a strategy is profitable or losing.
The summary only explains that the author recalled the quote while listening to a podcast and gives no further analysis.
keyPoints: 内容性质是Quantocracy的近期量化链接汇总，日期标注为2026年10月18日。
引语强调量化策略中的认知风险：误判策略盈亏状态。
摘要仅说明写作缘起为作者听播客时想到该引语，未提供进一步分析。
cards.limitationsEn: This item is only a link summary and contains no sample, methodology, backtest period, or statistical results from any original study, so it cannot be used to verify specific strategy conclusions. The quote is a personal opinion rather than an empirical finding, and the summary does not develop its context. The quality and timeliness of external linked content are not verified here; readers should consult the original sources.
cards.limitations: 该内容只是链接摘要，未包含任何原始研究的样本、方法、回测区间或统计结果，无法用于验证具体策略结论。引语属个人观点而非实证发现，摘要也未展开其上下文。链接所指向的外部内容质量与时效性未经本文核验，读者需回到原始来源自行判断。
cards.title: 量化链接合集提示策略认知偏差风险
cards.descriptionEn: This is an aggregator-style link summary whose value lies in collecting recent quant community discussions and using a Jeff Yass quote to highlight a core risk: mistaking a losing strategy for a winning one. For quant researchers, it serves as a pointer to community trends and a prompt to question strategy evaluation assumptions.
